pages.text: A Cleansegleam is an Arcane Gem formed from a blue-spectrum piece of $(l:arcanearchives:items/shapedquartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$(/l) in an asscher cut.$(br2)When activated, a Cleansegleam will purge the user of Hunger, Nausea, and Poison at the cost of a point of charge.$(br2)If activated while sneaking, you can attempt to all targets within three blocks of you of these effects instead.
Antidote Any target affected by a Cleansegleam will also be immunized from poison for 60 seconds. This functionality only occurs when Potion Core is installed.
Cleansegleams can be crafted on a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/gemcutterstable)Gem Cutter's Table$(/l).
